common.lower: lowest intraday low from 2026-09-21 (BTC peak day) through 2026-10-08
common.ratio: synthetic close ratio COINUSDT close / BTCUSDT close; no direct COIN/BTC pair
common.breakout: daily close > upper AND ratio close >= ratioMax60 AND volume ratio >= 1.5 (prev 20 days, excl signal day)
common.pullback: starts at first daily close below previous close after breakout; must keep intraday low >= upper*0.97 and close >= upper, else breakout void and state returns to waiting-breakout
common.trigger: after pullback starts, first daily close > previous day high
common.invalidation: before trigger: close < lower OR ratio close < ratioMinSince0921 OR no breakout by 2026-11-07 close OR no trigger within 15 complete days after breakout
common.execution: simulated entry at next 00:00 UTC open after trigger close
common.stop: pullback lowest low * 0.99; intraday touch triggers; simulated fill at stop * 0.995
common.exit: stop or close of 30th complete daily candle after entry; no take-profit
